test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: F, G, H, I and J are sitting in a line facing south while R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a second line parallel to the first line and are facing north. I is second to the right of F, F is opposite to S. H and S are diagonally opposite to each other and at the extreme ends. G is opposite to V who is just next to the left of S. T who is the second to the left of V, is opposite to J. R is at one end of the line. Which of the following pairs is opposite to each other?
solution:
F, G, H, I and J are sitting in a line facing south while R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a second line parallel to the first line and are facing north.

1) I is second to the right of F, F is opposite to S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d05862f8d798ccf2cdcf24e640ce2943231325b8124526a3693d4b586545b405.png] 

2) G is opposite to V who is just next to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e869084908a880292c5af459af4fb3cd6afaa21258a3d642b2913e6994c64132.png] 

3) T who is the second to the left of V, is opposite to J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9b7d5fb00cf954d921d265f2189fe7ef340f12f1c8c30f0df1a9394bfeb4d66.png] 

4) R is at one end of the line and H and S are diagonally opposite to each other and at the extreme ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29db8db24e25a472de4f739449c74c4fe5ffe31e834000781402d50c448d3713.png] 

∴ Here, "HR, IU" pairs are opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is **"HR, IU".**
